items.q: Douglas Fairbanks, Senior was another star I enjoyed seeing although I don't remember him playing a cowboy role; he did play Zorro in the "Mark of Zorro"

ctx.x: I suppose that the reason I had no desire to play music when I was 14 and

and started to play in the kids band of Mr. Ernest Moore was because I was interested more in being a cowboy than anything else. Most of the movies I saw were of cowboys. Some of the stars of those films were William S. Hart, Tom Mix, Harry Carney and a man by the name of Noble Johnson whom I heard was a negro but he was as white as any of the other stars. Douglas Fairbanks, Senior was another star I enjoyed seeing although I don't remember him playing a cowboy role; he did play Zorro in the "Mark of Zorro" and…

I had a very good friend who was my favourite playmate. He lived on Barr Street but spent most of his playing time on Hathaway Street. His name was Edward Partridge and we remained friends after we grew to be men. Eddie and I used to draw pictures of horses and cowboys. Our dream was to go west and get a job on some ranch. There was one thing that puzzled me about Eddie's family it seemed that every six months at least, there was a new baby born at his house. I never knew how many brothers or sisters he had.
